title: SEND FUNNY MESSAGES ON CHAT
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local ChatEvent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents"):WaitForChild("SayMessageRequest")

local messages = {
    "Who stole my pizza? 🍕😂",
    "I am the invisible superhero! 🦸‍♂️",
    "Does anyone else talk to their pets like humans?",
    "BRB, going to find Bigfoot 🦶👣",
    "I swear this game has 99% gravity and 1% chaos!",
    "Is it just me or is Brookhaven a giant playground?",
    "Can someone teach me how to fly? 🕊️",
    "I just tried to open a door with a spoon... it didn’t work.",
    "Why walk when you can dance? 💃🕺",
    "I’m secretly a potato 🥔 shhh!"
}

while true do
    local message = messages[math.random(1, #messages)]
    ChatEvent:FireServer(message, "All")
    wait(10)
end
